content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles, especially when sentiment is bullish.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with price overshoots, suggesting sentiment drives short-term volatility.", "Models exhibit mean-reversion bias in later cycles, underestimating sharp declines after peaks.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with historical price patterns, indicating sentiment calibration is critical.", "Lagging sentiment signals often precede price corrections, suggesting models should adjust for delayed sentiment impact.", "High sentiment volatility correlates with forecast divergence, indicating models struggle with sentiment noise.", "Models show persistent bias toward upward trends when sentiment is uniformly positive, requiring bias correction.", "Forecast accuracy drops when sentiment shifts abruptly, highlighting the need for sentiment transition sensitivity."]}
